features.name: flying dragon racer
features.notes: Main playable character in the course
features.quote: The player controls a 3D dragon character.

features.name: floating ring sequence
features.notes: Multiple rings arranged along the flight course in a specific numbered order
features.quote: Create a system for placing floating rings in the environment.

features.name: numbered course rings
features.notes: Visible numbering should communicate the required sequence
features.quote: The player must fly through the rings in a specific, numbered order.

features.name: yellow active ring
features.notes: At least one ring in yellow as the active target
features.quote: change the ring's color (e.g., from yellow to green)

features.name: green completed rings
features.notes: Completed rings visibly distinct from active ring
features.quote: change the ring's color (e.g., from yellow to green)

features.name: point to point course
features.notes: Course begins at one location and ends at another
features.quote: A course that starts in one place and ends in another

features.name: open aerial race volume
features.notes: Course extends through open three dimensional airspace rather than only a ground track
features.quote: Racing through a volume rather than across a surface — swimming lanes, flight circuits.

features.name: terminal finish gate
features.notes: At the exact end of the course
features.quote: Terminal Finish: The built finish at the exact end of the course

features.name: off track water hazards
features.notes: Water bordering or below the intended flight corridor
features.quote: Off-Track Penalty: Water, gravel, or fall-away edges punishing racers who leave the corridor.

features.name: fall away course edges
features.notes: Visible dangerous edges outside the race corridor
features.quote: Water, gravel, or fall-away edges punishing racers who leave the corridor.
